events.name: Overnight oats (LF) with chia & berries
instructions: Mix oats, chia, and milk in a jar.

events.name: Apple slices with peanut butter
instructions: Spread or dip with peanut butter.

events.name: Chicken & avocado lettuce cups
instructions: Mash avocado with lemon and oil.

events.name: Air-fryer salmon + veg tray
instructions: Toss veg with 1 tsp oil and garlic.
Air-fry 8–10 min; add salmon brushed with 1 tsp oil; cook 7–9 min until 145°F.

events.name: Cottage bowl (LF) with peach & oats
instructions: Top cottage cheese with peaches and oats.

events.name: Air‑fryer chicken bites (light panko)
instructions: Mist basket; air‑fry 380°F 10–12 min, shaking once.

events.name: Egg scramble (1 egg + whites) & toast
instructions: Heat oil; scramble eggs with spinach.

events.name: Carrot‑ginger puree (microwave)
instructions: Blend steamed carrots with milk and ginger until smooth.

events.name: Turkey chili (low‑Na, crock‑pot)
instructions: Combine all in crock‑pot; cook LOW 4–6 hrs or HIGH 2–3 hrs.

events.name: Warm cinnamon oats (LF)
instructions: Microwave oats & milk 2–3 min; stir in cinnamon.

events.name: Lentil soup (low‑Na, boxed)
instructions: Heat per package; finish with oil.

events.name: Avocado toast (soft bread)
instructions: Mash avocado; spread on toast; lemon on top.

events.name: Air‑fryer turkey meatballs + veg
instructions: Mix turkey, panko, egg; form small balls.

events.name: Oatmeal (LF) + blueberries
instructions: Microwave oats & milk 2–3 min; fold in berries.

events.name: Soft‑boiled egg + toast
instructions: Simmer egg 6–7 min; run under cold water; peel.

events.name: Air‑fryer cod + potatoes (soft)
instructions: Microwave potatoes 4–5 min until soft; toss with oil.

events.name: Cinnamon rice pudding (LF)
instructions: Simmer rice with milk 3–4 min; add cinnamon.

events.name: Soft banana + PB wrap
instructions: Spread PB; add banana; roll up.

events.name: Tomato‑cucumber salad (peeled, easy)
instructions: Chop and toss with oil & lemon.

events.name: Turkey skillet (single burner)
instructions: Brown turkey with oil; add veg; sauté until hot.

events.name: Bean & rice bowl (microwave)
instructions: Microwave rice; fold in warmed beans, oil, lime.

events.name: Air‑fryer chicken & veg tray
instructions: Toss veg with oil; air‑fry 380°F 8–10 min.
Add chicken; cook 8–10 min more until 165°F.
